name: Genui
description: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的专业能力扩展插件，提供免配置一键安装与高效辅助支持。
descriptionEn: GenUI for DeepSeek Harness: interactive UI components rendered inline in assistant replies via the dsh-ui fence — layout, charts, plots, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model. Ships the fence-teaching host plugin, the browser renderer (client half), and the genui skill.
author: MingLin
